name: surprise
quote: I didn't expect you to be there!
description: A sudden spike in energy in response to an unexpected positive or negative experience.

variations.name: positive surprise
variations.description: A surge of energy about something unexpectedly fun and positive.
examples: I'd expected the trip to be good, but it was surprisingly good.

variations.name: negative surprise
variations.description: A surge of energy about something unexpected and threatening.
examples: The kids knocked the vase off the shelf, surprising everyone with a loud noise.

commentaries.quote: When the unexpected happens, there's generally a moment of confusion while you try to figure out what happened. In a very short time, you can go from surprise to fear to relief to joy.

conditions: Something unexpected has aroused your energy level.
